_doc: The tuning layer tune.py keeps (gen.py reads it): config (battle_config numbers by section.key, written to battle_config.json dataset_overrides.kanto so the v1 fixtures keep the plain numbers), balance (deep-merged into the design balance), species (stats and focus deltas), moves (power factors), log (every change and why).

log.why: the TCG has no immunities; with them Gastly topped the Lv 14 commons at 0.85 because half its peers fight with Normal moves. Foresight still lifts the reduction. Flagged for the user.

peer spreads stayed near 0.5 with half of each species' stat-total gap kept; pulling harder toward the group mean lets typing, moves and focus decide more

log.why: past about 40 the offset stopped moving the level step (0.90 at 53, 0.87 at 86): what's left is new moves and slots, which is the step we want; 30 keeps HP and stats growing with levels so Ash feels it
ten levels is a new move or two and a slot; a 60-78% edge made levels feel flat. A design call, flagged for the user
sleep moves decided short battles: Drowzee (Hypnosis) 0.90 and Paras (Spore) 0.75 at Lv 20, Gastly and Jigglypuff swinging with their sleep move's level
extreme stat lines (Chansey's Defense 5, the glass cannons) survived the total pull; Chansey lost every peer game (0.00 to 0.04 at every level)

log.change: battle_sim loadout: status moves valued by the planner's status_value x accuracy (sim, not data)
log.why: the sim's trainer equipped the first status move it found (Copycat over Soft-Boiled, Sing over Charm), which made the same species swing from 0.88 to 0.15 between levels

disruption.repeat_mult 0.5 and disruption.floor 20 (by hand; engine: per-move disrupt from the data first, then the config)
log.why: cheap disruption stun-locked: Drowzee chained Confusion four times a turn (the v1 config's 15-point step for Confusion overrode the Kanto 5) and held Rattata at 0% focus for six turns. Each further disruption in a turn now bites half as hard and focus never drops below one chip's worth
